verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a scraping API service, but the evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. It covers synchronous API calls, a usage-polling API, and CLI cron schedules, none of which are webhooks. Missing for 10: any documented webhook registration, event types, and callback delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
